learning_outcomes.text: Describe the ancient and late-antique foundations of the Middle East
Explain the rise of Islam and the early caliphates
Analyse the great Islamic empires and their societies
Evaluate the impact of Ottoman rule and its long decline
Explain European imperialism, mandates and the emergence of modern states
Assess the major political and social dynamics of the region since 1945

integrative_case: A documentary team must explain 'why the modern map of the Middle East looks as it does' in five episodes: choose decisive moments from late antiquity to the present, justify each, and show how empire, religion and 20th-century diplomacy interact without reducing the story to one factor.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
